title: Introduction to Web Development with Flask/Django
description: Get started with web development in Python using Flask and Django, two popular web frameworks for building web applications.

lessons.title: What is Web Development?
lessons.content: Web development involves creating websites or web applications accessible via browsers. It includes frontend (UI) and backend (server, database) development.

lessons.title: Overview of Flask
lessons.content: Flask is a lightweight, micro web framework in Python, known for its simplicity and flexibility, ideal for small to medium web apps.

lessons.title: Overview of Django
lessons.content: Django is a full-featured Python web framework that follows the MVC pattern, offering built-in features like ORM, authentication, and admin panel.

lessons.title: Setting Up Flask Environment
lessons.content:
Install Flask and run a basic app:
```
pip install flask
```
```python
from flask import Flask
app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/')
def home():
    return 'Hello, Flask!'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)
```

lessons.title: Setting Up Django Environment
lessons.content:
Install Django and create a project:
```
pip install django
```
```
django-admin startproject mysite
cd mysite
python manage.py runserver
```

lessons.title: Routing and Views in Flask
Routing and Views in Django
lessons.content:
Configure URLs and views:
```python
# urls.py
from django.urls import path
from . import views
urlpatterns = [
    path('', views.home, name='home'),
]

# views.py
def home(request):
    from django.http import HttpResponse
    return HttpResponse('Hello, Django!')
```

lessons.title: Templates and Rendering in Flask
lessons.content:
Use Jinja2 templates: ```python from flask import render_template @app.route('/hello/') def hello(name): return render_template('hello.html', name=name) ``` Template example: ```html

Hello, {{ name }}!

```

lessons.title: Templates and Rendering in Django
lessons.content:
Use Django templates: ```python # views.py def hello(request, name): return render(request, 'hello.html', {'name': name}) ``` Template example: ```html

Hello, {{ name }}!

```

lessons.title: Basic Database Operations with Django ORM
lessons.content:
Define models and query data:
```python
from django.db import models

class Person(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    age = models.IntegerField()

# Query example
persons = Person.objects.all()
```
